verdict.rationale: Yubico's official ykman CLI is scriptable and documented for device info, enabled applications, and PIV/OATH/OTP slot management. The firmware docs name ykman as a way to read the firmware version, and SDKs (python-fido2, .NET, YubiKit) allow reading from code. Fleet-wide auditing is not covered: the YubiEnterprise REST API only handles delivery, inventory and shipment, not live device state. So an agent would have to run ykman locally against each attached key and aggregate the results itself. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of serial and stored-credential enumeration, documented machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output, a centralized fleet-state API, and hands-on corroboration of an audit workflow.
